content_blocks.code:
import asyncio

async def main():
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    print("Task completed")

asyncio.run(main())
content_blocks.run_instructions: Run with python main.py. Async is useful for concurrent I/O; it does not automatically make CPU-bound work faster.

content_blocks.title: Version and reliability note
content_blocks.text: Security-sensitive topics require explicit trust boundaries. Never use pickle for untrusted data, avoid shell command strings built from user input, and do not commit credentials.
